local_checks.invariant: Refresh rotation is atomic against concurrent use
local_checks.result: Not atomic; the schema has only a unique token_hash index, nothing enforces single use. Same root cause as the refresh candidate.

local_checks.invariant: Concurrent registrations cannot create duplicate emails
local_checks.result: existsBy then save is racy but the unique index on lower(email) (V1:11) is authoritative, so no duplicate; a losing racer gets a constraint-violation error. Role is hard-coded to STUDENT.

local_checks.invariant: The platform is never left with zero administrators
local_checks.result: Guard is countByRole then save with no transaction, lock or constraint; two admins demoting each other concurrently could leave zero. Admin-only trigger, no privilege gain; bootstrap recreates an admin on restart. Hardening only.

_hardening: Reuse of a consumed refresh token returns 401 but does not revoke the descendant tokens or family.
ChangeRoleService last-admin guard is count-then-save without a transaction.
A role change or demotion does not revoke the target's refresh tokens or outstanding access JWT (up to 900 s).
auth-service enforces no role check itself; assert X-User-Role there too (defence in depth).
RoleChangeController lacks @Valid, so a null role gives an NPE/500.

local_checks.invariant: Throttle keys are scoped to the real client and throttle state is bounded
local_checks.result: The per-address key is getRemoteAddr() with no forward-headers strategy, so behind the gateway all clients share one key: 5 failures in 60 s throttle every login. failuresByKey is a ConcurrentHashMap whose keys are never evicted (only cleared on a successful login for that email), so attacker-chosen emails grow it. Per-email key also allows targeted lockout.

local_checks.invariant: BCrypt work before authentication is bounded
local_checks.result: BCrypt runs only when the account exists and the key is not throttled; cost is fixed (72-byte input) and limited by the 5-failure throttle and the shared gateway bucket. No further pre-auth amplification.

_hardening: No @Valid on any request body, so @NotBlank/@NotNull are inert; add @Valid, @Email and @Size limits.
JwtIssuer and gateway verifier use no iss/aud/nbf.
PasswordHasher uses default BCrypt cost 10 with no maximum password length; consider a cap and cost 12+.
Add a dummy BCrypt match when the account is unknown to remove the login timing difference.
RegisterController accepts and returns an unvalidated email (empty or whitespace can persist).

local_checks.invariant: No hidden, compatibility or fallback path lets a request skip route policy or identity-header stripping
local_checks.result: Grep of both main trees for TODO/hack/legacy/bypass/@Profile/ConditionalOn/permitAll found no bypass or conditional security path. Strip runs before the public check; no-route falls to the token check (fail closed). PATCH on /api/v1/reviews/** matches no route. No gateway route reaches /api/v1/internal/**.

local_checks.invariant: Valid-account actions cannot affect other accounts' sessions or roles; the role claim is bound to account state at issuance and refresh
local_checks.result: Logout requires the token's account to equal the caller; refresh re-reads the role from the DB. A demoted role stays valid up to 900 s (documented FR-021, hardening).

local_checks.invariant: Environment and data-state assumptions do not open an identity or isolation gap
local_checks.result: DB enforces unique lower(email) and a role CHECK; internal lookup returns only id and email; error bodies are fixed; no test-only class or config packaged in src/main.

attempts.reassignment_reason: Post-wave-1 critic: unit closed on a thin read; the wildcard pass touched many files shallowly and left lifecycle and fallback paths unexamined.

local_checks.invariant: The half-finished service-to-service endpoint /api/v1/internal/accounts/{id} is not reachable through the gateway
local_checks.result: No gateway route matches /api/v1/internal/**; RealGatewayConfigTest asserts it (noRouteEverTargetsInternalPaths:293); no catch-all route exists. Direct-port bypass is the deployment lead.

local_checks.invariant: The platform is never left with zero administrators and the bootstrap recovery works if it is
local_checks.result: Independently found the same non-atomic last-admin guard (duplicate of the wave-1 lifecycle finding, consolidated). RoleChangeIT tests only sequential calls. Bootstrap would insert a new account with the configured email and could hit the unique lower(email) index.

local_checks.invariant: Gateway fallback and compatibility branches fail closed
local_checks.result: Null route is protected; public flag parsed as Boolean or the string true, anything else stays protected; rolesOf accepts List or indexed Map; SignedJWT.parse rejects unsigned/alg=none; MACVerifier accepts only HMAC; identity headers stripped before the public branch. No fail-open branch. Tests do not cover alg=none, non-enum role or path normalisation.

local_checks.invariant: API-only inputs the SPA never sends (null, over-long) are rejected without a security-relevant effect
local_checks.result: No @Valid: null email/password gives an NPE and generic 500 with no body leak; email over 320 chars gives a 500; no maximum password length but BCrypt cost is bounded. Registration check-then-insert is backstopped by the unique index. Robustness only.

local_checks.invariant: Session and lifecycle operations bind to the caller and the right principal
local_checks.result: Logout checks the token record's account equals the caller and returns an identical 401 otherwise; refresh tokens are 256-bit SecureRandom stored only as SHA-256 hashes; /me reads only the gateway-injected id. Rotation race and post-demotion lifetime are owned by other leads.

local_checks.invariant: Client-controlled correlation ID and error paths cannot inject into logs or JSON or leak internals
local_checks.result: CorrelationIds.resolve accepts only ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{8,64}$, so the concatenated JSON fallback is safe; problem detail is a fixed phrase per status; 5xx log includes error.toString() server-side only; EnvironmentChangeEvent resets rate-limit buckets (GatewayConfiguration:108-111), used in the actuator lead.

local_checks.invariant: Fallback keys and strict-route selection in the rate limiter do not allow bypass
local_checks.result: A null remote address maps to a shared 'unknown' bucket (not a bypass); XFF ignored; the strict bucket is chosen by route metadata only. Shared-bucket and unbounded-key issues are already reported.

local_checks.invariant: Test-only configuration and fixtures cannot leak into runtime; test gaps identified
local_checks.result: Test secrets live only in src/test/resources, not on the main classpath; test profiles disable the config client. Untested: concurrent last-admin demotion, concurrent refresh, alg=none and non-enum role tokens, admin-route path normalisation, null bodies, and actuator refresh auth.

_hardening: Extend .gitignore to .env.*, *.pem, *.key, *.p12, *.jks and keystores, keeping .env.example re-included.
Add @Valid to request bodies and cap email and password length (BCrypt ignores bytes after 72).
Pin management.server.port to a non-published port or restrict actuator endpoints instead of exposing refresh on the app port, even under the local profile.
No TLS or HSTS end to end; terminate TLS in front of nginx for any non-local deployment.
Dependency CVE status of Spring Boot 3.5.15, Spring Cloud 2025.0.3 (end-of-line) and nimbus-jose-jwt 10.10 was not verified offline; run an SCA scan.
JwtVerifier does not check the role claim against the Role enum, or iss/aud/nbf.
toLowerCase() without Locale.ROOT in RegisterAccountService, AuthenticateService and BootstrapAdministrator.

local_checks.invariant: Basic exposure checklist: CORS, actuator, secrets in source, debug gating, gitignore, TODO/FIXME
local_checks.result: CORS uses an explicit three-origin allow-list with credentials, no wildcard origin; actuator exposes health,info only (refresh only in the local profile); no hardcoded secrets, key blocks or security TODOs in gateway, auth-service or config-repo; .gitignore covers .env; no cookies, redirects or debug toggles in scope. TLS is not enforced (deployment hardening).

attempts.reassignment_reason: Post-wave-1 critic: unit closed on a thin read; the obvious-things checklist was answered in one summary check without item-by-item evidence.

local_checks.invariant: Item 1: no hardcoded passwords, keys or tokens in source
local_checks.result: .env.example holds only change-me-* placeholders; compose uses ${VAR:?required} for every secret; auth-service.yml carries no secrets; the only literals are test fixtures under src/test; no BEGIN KEY or Bearer literals in main sources; .env not read.

local_checks.invariant: Item 2: no TODO, FIXME, HACK or XXX security comments
local_checks.result: Case-insensitive grep for TODO, FIXME, HACK, XXX, backdoor and insecure across both main trees and config-repo returned zero matches.

local_checks.invariant: Item 3: debug and dev mode is gated and cannot be enabled by request
local_checks.result: No debug/trace/dev toggles in either service. The only profile-driven difference is application-local.yml adding actuator refresh; the profile is set by environment, not request. .env.example:8 defaults it to local (see actuator lead).

local_checks.invariant: Item 4: no test, example or seed credentials work in production
local_checks.result: Compose requires ADMIN_*/JWT_SIGNING_SECRET but accepts the placeholder values (already reported as the placeholder-secrets lead); test credentials exist only under src/test.

local_checks.invariant: Item 5: no unprotected /debug, /admin, /test, /status, /health, /metrics, /env or /config endpoint
local_checks.result: Exposure is health,info with show-details never; no env/metrics/heapdump. Under the default local profile refresh is also exposed on the app port (9080, 9001), and gateway global filters do not cover actuator endpoints, so POST /actuator/refresh looks unauthenticated. Recorded as the actuator-refresh lead.

local_checks.invariant: Item 6: no .env, pem, key or credentials file is committed
local_checks.result: git ls-files matches only .env.example; no .pem/.key/.p12/.jks/credentials*; git log -- .env shows no history; .env exists on disk only, ignored, not read.

local_checks.invariant: Item 7: .gitignore covers secrets, uploads and local config
local_checks.result: Covers .env and re-includes .env.example, but not .env.local, .env.*, *.pem, *.key, *.p12, *.jks or keystores. Hardening only; no such file exists now.

local_checks.invariant: Item 8: dependencies are pinned and have no known-vulnerable versions
local_checks.result: spring-boot-starter-parent 3.5.15, Spring Cloud 2025.0.3, nimbus-jose-jwt 10.10 pinned, WireMock 3.13.2; no version ranges or SNAPSHOT third-party deps; child poms declare no versions. CVE status cannot be verified offline; Spring Cloud 2025.0.3 is end-of-line (hardening).

local_checks.invariant: Item 9: no eval, exec, child process, dynamic class loading or SpEL on input
local_checks.result: grep for Runtime.getRuntime, ProcessBuilder, ScriptEngine, Class.forName, ObjectInputStream, SpelExpressionParser returned zero matches; JPA access goes through Spring Data repositories.

local_checks.invariant: Item 10: CORS is not wildcard with credentials
local_checks.result: allowed-origins is three explicit localhost origins with allow-credentials true and allowed-headers '*'; no wildcard origin; tokens travel in the Authorization header, not cookies.

local_checks.invariant: Item 11: cookies carry HttpOnly, Secure and SameSite flags
local_checks.result: No Set-Cookie, ResponseCookie or addCookie in either service; tokens are in the JSON body. Not applicable.

local_checks.invariant: Item 12: no open redirect via redirect, return, next, url or goto parameters
local_checks.result: No sendRedirect, RedirectView or Location handling; no controller reads a redirect-style parameter; nginx proxy_pass uses a fixed GATEWAY_URL. Not applicable.

local_checks.invariant: Item 13: TLS is enforced and no HTTP-only endpoints carry sensitive data
local_checks.result: nginx listens on 80 only and all hops are plain HTTP, including tokens and login passwords; no TLS or HSTS in compose. Deployment limitation for a Compose-only target (hardening).

local_checks.invariant: Item 14: error responses do not return stack traces, internal paths or SQL errors
local_checks.result: Gateway returns a fixed detail phrase per status, never an exception message; neither service sets include-stacktrace/include-message/include-binding-errors and there is no custom ControllerAdvice, so Boot defaults (never) apply.
